incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-eu-embeddings (high). Trigger: 5xx spike on embed-worker-prod-eu. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

pagerbot: Auto-assign attempt: oncall-sre -> Jordan C (ack required)

Jordan C: acked. I'm on it. Looking at graphs now.

Samir K: thx. can you confirm scope? is this regionally isolated to eu?

Jordan C: preliminary — looks EU only, backbone -> eu-west-1. latency stable but 5xx rate up ~18% on worker pool.

Li-Wei: I've got a synthetic probe running. embedding latency is fine, failures are all 502 from model router (k8s svc). Stack shows upstream 503 from inference-runtime pods.

Michelle R: customer-impact check: inbound error rate map shows customers A+B seeing failures; support ticket #INC-8821 opened. Notified account team.

Jordan C: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embed-worker -o wide`

```
NAME                          READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
embed-worker-7d9b2            1/1     Running   0          3d    node-eu-03
embed-worker-8bb4f            0/1     CrashLoop 4          2h    node-eu-02
embed-worker-ff33a            1/1     Running   0          3d    node-eu-01
```

Jordan C: 8bb4f is crashlooping. pulling logs.

Jordan C: logs show OOM in the model runtime when batch size spikes: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` — looks like an infrequent traffic pattern produced a large batch.

Samir K: ok can we scale down batch size via config? or roll back a recent model change?

Li-Wei: there was an autoscale bump earlier that increased batch window. I can flip the window to 20ms. Patch: `PATCH /v1/runtime/config {"batch_window_ms":20}`

Jordan C: applying now. executing curl to control plane.

pagerbot: Command executed by Jordan C: `curl -X PATCH https://control.redwood/api/runtime/config -d '{"batch_window_ms":20}'` -> 200 OK

Jordan C: batch window reduced. spinning new pod for embed-worker-8bb4f via rollout restart. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-worker`

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident status=acknowledged, assignee=Jordan C

Michelle R: customer-impact update: Support updated customers A+B, advising degraded embeddings; SLA impact limited but we should track.

Samir K: monitoring CPU/mem and 5xx rate. if it drops below 1% for 10m we can handoff.

Jordan C: pod restarted, 8bb4f back to Running. logs show no OOMs post-change. 5xx rate down to 4% (was 18%).

Li-Wei: synthetic probes green, embeddings success rate back to 99.2% in region.

Samir K: great. I'm taking ownership — need to pair-check postmortem notes and runbook. Jordan, can you handoff? I have a meeting in 8m.

Jordan C: handing off to Samir K. Steps done: reduced batch window, restarted deployment, notified support. Next actions: monitor for 30m, capture heap dumps if OOMs recur, prepare hotfix to limit batch size at router if needed. PD incident updated.

pagerbot: Ownership transfer recorded: previous=Jordan C, new=Samir K.

Samir K: acked takeover. I'll keep the bridge open and ping every 5m until stable.

Michelle R: noted for post-incident comms. I'll draft a short customer update and link the postmortem when ready.

Jordan C: thanks — leaving bridge. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Alert suppressed; no new pages for 10m. If metric regressions occur, new page will fire.

Samir K: final check at +30m: 5xx sustained <1%, rolling metrics look good. Moving to monitoring-only.

Michelle R: captured timeline and initial RCA draft -> https://confluence.example/incidents/PD12345-rca

Samir K: closing PD incident in 10m if stable. Assigning follow-up action to infra team to add protective limit on router batch size.

Jordan C: (reacted :eyes:) good catch.

pagerbot: PD incident PD12345 marked as resolved by Samir K at 4876543470.

Michelle R: thanks everyone. filing a blameless postmortem and action items. :heart:
